publishing_model.principle: one evidence package, platform-specific script and render; no duplicate topic research

morning.preferred_content: current high-intent trend, search demand, strong visual payoff

evening.preferred_content: active series episode or recurring explainer with next-episode bridge

content_rules: Every series episode must work as a standalone video.
Do not open with a series number; earn attention with the hook first.
Place the series marker visually after the hook or in metadata.
CTA comes after the factual payoff and should promise the next useful episode, not beg for follows.
Never add filler only to reach TikTok duration; add a second factual payoff instead.
Run the global duplicate gate before production for both standalone and series stories.
The same researched story may have YouTube and TikTok variants; that is a platform variant, not a duplicate topic.

measurement.decision_rule: After at least 30 published platform variants, compare formats against the channel's own rolling baseline and prioritize repeatable winners instead of fixed vanity thresholds.
